description: Learn how to use borders, border radius, divide utilities, ring outlines, box shadows, and visual effects in Tailwind CSS.

slides.title: Borders & Effects Overview
slides.content:
# Borders, Rings & Effects in Tailwind 🛡️✨

Borders, shadows, and outlines give interfaces structure, elevation, and depth. Tailwind provides comprehensive utilities for:

- **Border Radius** (`rounded-*`): From soft corners to pills and circles
- **Border Width & Styles** (`border-*`, `border-dashed`)
- **Divide Utilities** (`divide-y`, `divide-x`): Borders between child elements
- **Ring Utilities** (`ring-*`, `ring-offset-*`): Box-shadow outlines without layout shift
- **Box Shadows** (`shadow-*`): Multi-tier elevation scale
- **Opacity & Blend Modes**: Controlling transparency

slides.title: Border Radius Utilities
slides.content:
# Border Radius: Softening Corners 🔲

Round individual corners or all edges at once using `rounded-*`.

## Radius Scale Reference

| Class | CSS Value | Best Use Case |
|---|---|---|
| `rounded-none` | `0px` | Crisp tables, sharp cards |
| `rounded-sm` | `0.125rem` (2px) | Subtle buttons, badges |
| `rounded` | `0.25rem` (4px) | Form inputs, standard buttons |
| `rounded-md` | `0.375rem` (6px) | Cards, modals |
| `rounded-lg` | `0.5rem` (8px) | Modern dashboard widgets |
| `rounded-xl` | `0.75rem` (12px) | Feature cards |
| `rounded-2xl`| `1rem` (16px) | Floating dialogs |
| `rounded-3xl`| `1.5rem` (24px) | Mobile app containers |
| `rounded-full`| `9999px` | Circular avatars, pill badges |

## Directional Corners
- `rounded-t-lg` (top only), `rounded-b-lg` (bottom only)
- `rounded-l-full` (left only), `rounded-tr-xl` (top-right only)

slides.title: Ring Utilities: Superior Outlines
slides.content:
# Ring Utilities: Clean Outlines Without Layout Shift 💍

Standard CSS `border` increases an element's physical box size, which can cause layout shifts when toggled. `ring` uses CSS `box-shadow` to create crisp outlines that **never cause layout shift**.

## Ring Classes

- `ring` — `3px` outline
- `ring-1`, `ring-2`, `ring-4`, `ring-8` — Explicit pixel widths
- `ring-offset-{width}` — Adds white space between element and ring
- `ring-{color}` — Sets ring outline color

```html_not
<button class="bg-indigo-600 text-white px-5 py-2.5 rounded-lg
               focus:outline-none focus:ring-4 focus:ring-indigo-500/50 focus:ring-offset-2">
  Accessible Focus Ring
</button>
```

slides.title: Box Shadows & Elevation Scale
slides.content:
# Box Shadows & Elevation 🏔️ Tailwind's shadow utilities create natural elevation layers using multi-layer box shadows. ## Elevation Scale Reference | Class | Elevation Level | Typical Component | |---|---|---| | `shadow-sm` | Low / Subtle | Form inputs, pills | | `shadow` | Level 1 (Default) | Standard cards, action buttons | | `shadow-md` | Level 2 | Interactive cards on hover | | `shadow-lg` | Level 3 | Dropdown menus, sticky headers | | `shadow-xl` | Level 4 | Modal dialogs, notifications | | `shadow-2xl`| Level 5 | Lightboxes, floating popups | | `shadow-inner` | Inset shadow | Depressed inputs, wells | | `shadow-none` | Remove shadow | Flat elements | ```html_not

slides.title: Opacity Utilities
slides.content:
# Controlling Opacity 🌫️

The `opacity-*` utilities set the `opacity` property of an entire element (including all its children).

## Opacity Scale

- `opacity-0` (0% - fully transparent)
- `opacity-25` (25%)
- `opacity-50` (50%)
- `opacity-75` (75%)
- `opacity-100` (100% - fully opaque)

```html_not
<button disabled class="bg-blue-600 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed">
  Processing Transaction...
</button>
```

> ⚠️ **Important Distinction:** `opacity-50` makes the *whole element and its text* semi-transparent. If you only want a semi-transparent background, use `bg-blue-600/50` instead!

slides.title: Outline Utilities
slides.content: # Outline Utilities for Keyboard Accessibility ⌨️ Native CSS `outline` provides high-contrast focus rings for accessibility without modifying layout. ## Outline Classes - `outline-none` — Removes default browser focus ring (ensure you replace with `ring-*` or `focus:outline-*`!) - `outline` — Applies 2px solid outline - `outline-dashed`, `outline-dotted` - `outline-offset-2`, `outline-offset-4` — Space between element edge and outline - `outline-indigo-500` ```html_not Skip to content ```

slides.title: Transitions & Smooth State Changes
slides.content:
# Smooth Transitions with `transition-*` ⏱️

Animate changes to colors, shadows, borders, and transforms seamlessly.

## Transition Utilities

| Class | CSS `transition-property` |
|---|---|
| `transition` | `color, background-color, border-color, shadow, transform, opacity` |
| `transition-colors` | Color properties only (best performance for hover highlights) |
| `transition-opacity` | `opacity` only |
| `transition-transform` | `transform` (scale, translate, rotate) |
| `transition-all` | Every animatable property |

## Duration & Easing
- `duration-150`, `duration-200`, `duration-300`, `duration-500`
- `ease-in`, `ease-out`, `ease-in-out`

slides.title: Best Practices for Visual Depth
slides.content:
# Best Practices for Visual Depth & Hierarchy 🎯

1. **Never use pure black shadows** — Instead of `rgba(0,0,0,0.5)`, use tinted shadows like `shadow-slate-900/10` or `shadow-indigo-500/20`.
2. **Pair borders with subtle shadows** — A light border (`border-slate-100`) combined with `shadow-sm` makes cards crisp on low-contrast screens.
3. **Respect user motion preferences** — Wrap transforms with `motion-reduce:transition-none` for users sensitive to motion:
   ```html_not
   <button class="transition hover:scale-105 motion-reduce:hover:scale-100">
     Accessible Button
   </button>
   ```
4. **Always provide accessible focus rings** — Pair `focus:outline-none` with `focus:ring-2`.

slides.title: Summary: Borders & Effects
slides.content:
# Borders & Effects: Summary 📋

## Key Takeaways
- **Radius**: Control curves with `rounded-sm` up to `rounded-full`.
- **Borders**: Set thickness with `border-{n}` and style with `border-dashed`.
- **Divide**: Add effortless borders between children with `divide-y` and `divide-x`.
- **Rings**: Leverage `ring-*` for zero-layout-shift focus rings and avatar borders.
- **Shadows**: Create depth with `shadow-*` and atmospheric glow with `shadow-{color}`.
- **Transforms**: Nudge and elevate with `hover:-translate-y-1` and `hover:scale-105`.
